title: Le stage qui change la décision
titleEn: The internship that changes the decision
summary: Karim compares two training paths and checks whether an internship fits the life he already has.

sentences.fr: Karim voulait changer de secteur, mais il ne pouvait pas quitter son emploi immédiatement.
sentences.en: Karim wanted to change fields, but he could not leave his job right away.

sentences.fr: Il a comparé deux formations : l'une avait des cours le soir, tandis que l'autre exigeait une présence le jour.
sentences.en: He compared two programs: one had evening classes, while the other required daytime attendance.

sentences.fr: La première proposait aussi un stage, ce qui lui permettrait de mettre ses compétences en pratique.
sentences.en: The first also offered an internship, which would let him put his skills into practice.

sentences.fr: Avant de s'inscrire, il a demandé si les heures de stage pouvaient être réparties sur plusieurs semaines.
sentences.en: Before enrolling, he asked whether the internship hours could be spread over several weeks.

sentences.fr: La conseillère lui a répondu que cela dépendrait de l'employeur et du calendrier du programme.
sentences.en: The adviser replied that it would depend on the employer and the program schedule.

sentences.fr: Karim a donc vérifié son budget et parlé de son projet avec sa famille.
sentences.en: Karim therefore checked his budget and discussed his plan with his family.

sentences.fr: Il choisira cette formation si l'horaire du stage reste compatible avec son travail.
sentences.en: He will choose this program if the internship schedule remains compatible with his job.
sentences.note: A condition makes advice more accurate: a program can be suitable only if its schedule and requirements fit the learner's situation.

quiz.prompt: Why could Karim not leave his current job immediately?
options: He needed to keep working while planning a career change
The training centre had rejected him
His family had chosen a different program
quiz.explain: The first sentence says he could not leave his job right away.

quiz.prompt: What would the internship allow Karim to do?
options: Complete the program during the day
quiz.explain: The third sentence says the internship would let him practise his skills.

quiz.prompt: What condition will affect Karim's choice?
options: Whether the program removes its internship
Whether the adviser changes the course content
Whether the internship schedule fits his job
Whether his family moves to another city
quiz.explain: The final sentence makes his choice conditional on schedule compatibility.
